All 11 tests pass.

`habit done <name> [yesterday|YYYY-MM-DD]` now works — no date arg still defaults to today, `yesterday` marks the prior UTC day, and an explicit `YYYY-MM-DD` is validated (invalid calendar dates like `2026-02-30` are rejected instead of silently rolling over). One caveat: since the date token is detected as the *last* argument, a multi-word habit name that itself ends in "yesterday" or a date-like string (e.g. a habit called "trip 2026-09-01") would be misparsed — this only matters if such names are actually used.
